title: Persisted assistant events drop stop_reason/usage — max_tokens cuts indistinguishable from natural stops
wanted_capability: Persisted per-turn assistant events in the harness event stream should carry the model step's stop_reason and usage, so after-the-fact forensics (and orchestrators reading events.jsonl) can distinguish an output-token-cap cut (max_tokens mid-thinking) from a natural end_turn without relying on the suspicious-turn-end diagnostics only emitted at session termination.
missing_primitive: emit.rs assistant_message (crates/bro-harness/src/emit.rs:137-147) serializes only role+content; the harness tracks last_model_stop internally but surfaces it solely in turn_end diagnostics / the terminal result's suspicious_turn_end (post-ffd3996f). Per-turn stop_reason/usage never reach the persisted assistant event.
fallback_used: Infer from terminal suspicious_turn_end (only fires on suspicious stops) or from message_delta stream events when streaming was captured; non-terminal max_tokens cuts mid-session remain invisible in persisted events.
evidence: Split from gap-aa032081 evidence item 5 (live repro: deepseek session 557fdac2, 9,499-char thinking-only terminal turn, persisted events stop_reason=None/usage=None)
ffd3996f fixed termination behavior but did not touch per-turn event persistence
suggested_owner: bro-harness / coordinate with harness-dispatch-economics thread (9dfe1da5) before editing agent_loop.rs/emit.rs
resolution_note: Fixed in 65b74d9: per-step assistant events in events.jsonl now carry stop_reason (Anthropic vocabulary, Other passes through) + usage (input/output/cache tokens) from the same TurnOutput fields the suspicious-turn-end diagnostics read. Additive/optional — old logs and consumers parse unchanged. Known residual: OpenAI Responses maps any incomplete status to max_tokens (content_filter indistinguishable there; transport mapping widening is a separate follow-up).
